one_line_verdict: Ready to host as a static site. Single file 165 KB / 49 KB gzip (was 358 / 197 KB). The dist/site deploy folder is 149 KB / 36 KB gzip, self-hosts its fonts and makes 0 third-party requests. A config.js typo now stops the build with the line number; robust to broken config (0 JS errors in 12 cases); CLS ≤0.004; hero canvas settles to ~0% CPU after 15 s. GitHub Actions and Netlify deploy files are included.
top_remaining_issue: The final build has one new Nu validator error. The new 'Why we're running this' block in team.html line 57, <div class="tm-why" aria-labelledby="tm-why-title">, may not carry aria-labelledby on a plain div. Make it a <section> or add role="region"; or drop the attribute. Then set SITE.siteUrl once hosting is decided so the og:image, canonical link and sitemap switch on.
